[[Allen County War Memorial Coliseum]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2018–19 Summit League men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Purdue Fort Wayne Mastodons men's basketball team''' represented [[Purdue University Fort Wayne]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mastodons were led by fifth-year head coach [[Jon Coffman]] and split their home games between the [[Hilliard Gates Sports Center|Gates Sports Center]] and the [[Allen County War Memorial Coliseum]] as members of the [[Summit League]]. The season was the first in which Mastodons represented the new Purdue University Fort Wayne (PFW). The team previously represented the now defunct [[Indiana University – Purdue University Fort Wayne]]. On July 1, 2018, IPFW split into two separate institutions,{{Cite news|url=http://www.insideindianabusiness.com/story/35684109/purdue-iu-finalize-ipfw-realignment|title=Purdue, IU Finalize IPFW Realignment|last=Brown|first=Alex|access-date=2018-01-24|language=en}} with [[Indiana University|IU]] taking responsibility for IPFW's degree programs in health sciences and [[Purdue University system|Purdue]] retaining all other academic programs. The Mastodons have since represented PFW.{{cite web|url=http://www.jconline.com/story/news/college/2017/04/21/goodbye-ipfw-hello-purdue-fort-wayne/100471284/|title=Goodbye IPFW, hello Purdue Fort Wayne|date=April 21, 2017|publisher=Journal & Courier, a division of Gannett Company, Inc.|accessdate=December 3, 2017}} With the name change, the school's colors changed from Royal Blue and White to the Old Gold and Black used by the other three Purdue University campuses.{{cite web|url=http://www.ipfw.edu/about/future/faq.html|title=Frequently Asked Questions/Additional Questions|publisher=Indiana University–Purdue University Fort Wayne|accessdate=December 3, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171204114558/http://www.ipfw.edu/about/future/faq.html|archive-date=2017-12-04|url-status=dead}} On June 18, 2018, the school announced that beginning July 1, 2018 all NCAA sports teams would be known as the Purdue Fort Wayne Mastodons.{{Cite web|url=http://www.gomastodons.com/news/2018/6/18/general-purdue-fort-wayne-branding-released.aspx|title=Purdue Fort Wayne Branding Released|website=Fort Wayne|language=en|access-date=June 18, 2018}} In addition, a new logo was revealed where the color blue has been incorporated as a secondary color to the university's official school colors of gold and black. == Previous season == The [[2017–18 Fort Wayne Mastodons men's basketball team|Mastodons]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 18–15, 7–7 in Summit League play to finish in fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Summit League men's basketball tournament|Summit League tournament]] to [[2017–18 North Dakota State Bison men's basketball team|North Dakota State]]. They were invited to the [[2018 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsdier.com Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Central Michigan]].
